title: Personal Service Health Health Score Leaderboard
dataSources: Life service health (`lifeos:service`), personal scorecards (`lifeos:score`), breach notifications (`hibp:breach`), location visits (`location:visit`), runbook checklists (`runbook:checklist`), and Home Assistant outage events (`homeassistant:event`).
app: Apple and Google location exports, Have I Been Pwned breach alerts, Todoist-style personal runbooks, and Home Assistant outage events streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifeos:service health_score=*
| stats sum(health_score) as total_value, avg(health_score) as avg_value by service_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks service name values by total and average health score across personal service health events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `health_score` values for each personal service health event and review total and average health score by service name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total health score.

references.title: Have I Been Pwned API v3

grandmaExplanation: It compares which service name shows the biggest health score numbers in your personal service health data.
